name: ormi-random
description: Allow user to create random data

scripts.build-lib: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && tsc-alias -p tsconfig.build.json && copyfiles -u 1 'src/library/**/*.css' dist
scripts.clean: rm -rf dist && rm -rf node_modules && rm -rf bun.lockb
scripts.build: bun run clean && bun i && bun run build-lib && bun link
